method.list: Every model OpenRouter lists that names tools in its supported parameters, less free variants, colon variants of a listed model, tilde aliases, routers with no fixed price, preview ids whose stable id is listed, and models OpenRouter schedules for removal. Comfy's openrouter/chat-completions route forwards any OpenRouter model id unchanged.
method.score: Score: the mean over the boards that hold the model of 100 * (N - p) / (N - 1), p the best position of any row of the model and N the board's rows, rounded half up. Boards: the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index across every model its model page holds, deprecated ones too, and Arena text with style control. Rank by the unrounded mean, ties to more boards then newer. A model no board holds goes above its line's newest scored version when it is newer, else after the scored models, newest first. A newer version of a model line never ranks below an older one.
method.points: Each Artificial Analysis effort row of a model is a point, scored by the same blend over the boards holding that effort, with Artificial Analysis's published cost per task of its Intelligence Index at OpenRouter's price, and its output tokens per task. A point's onLine says whether it sits on the Pareto line of score against cost per task across every model.
method.openEffort: Among the efforts OpenRouter offers for the model: the highest-scoring point on the all-models line, else on its lab's line, else OpenRouter's default effort, else the model's first offered effort.
